gripOrHq.title: Employee Empowerment
gripOrHq.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

gripOrHq.title: Project Babylon
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

gripOrHq.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: Dedicated Response Team
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

heapOrArchives.title: Corprunner's Shattered Remains
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Shattered Remains before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Shattered Remains, trash one piece of hardware for each advancement counter on it.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Trojan Horse
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

discardCards.title: Credit Subversion
discardCards.rulesText: [T]: The Corp loses [3]. Use this ability immediately after a successful run on HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Netwatch Operations Office
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

ice.title: Fang
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].
